newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha prices slump, LSWR sentiment firmer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha prices slump, LSWR sentiment firmer.

text.p: Naphtha prices slumped in subdued Tokyo afternoon trade on Thursday, depressed by an overnight plunge in crude prices, traders said.
"I don't think we will see any aggressive selling until we see where Europe opens," one naphtha trader said.
Open-spec naphtha for first-half February was quoted at $219.00/222.00. It was sold at $224.50 to a Singapore trader on Wednesday.
Second-half January was notionally assessed at $221.50/224.50, compared with $225.00/226.50 in late Wednesday trade.
